basic_info.description: Perched atop Russian Hill in the iconic Bellaire Tower, this delightful sun drenched condo offers incredible views of San Francisco's landmarks & a sophisticated blend of stunning architecture & modern design. This timeless space in the heart of Russian Hill is bathed in AM light, & welcomes you w/sweeping  vistas of the Golden Gate Bridge, SF Bay, Marin Headlands, and Sutro Tower. Updated kitchen features honed granite countertops & stainless appliances. Original deco light fixtures complement the home's details with w/archways, moldings, & plaster walls reflecting Bellaire Tower's 1930 Art Deco heritage. The 920 sq ft layout maximizes space w/ample closets, a serene BR retreat, & spacious BA enjoying skyline views w/separate tub & shower. Valet pkg & storage complete the residence. Bellaire Tower, designed by H.C. Baumann, is a Russian Hill icon w/its Art Deco facade & ornate lobby. Residents of the prestigious bldg enjoy unparalleled amenities including 24-hr doorman, elevator, valet pkg, & in-building laundry. Hyde Street & Polk Corridor offer some of SF's best dining & shopping.  Adjacent unit #802 is also for sale, offering more possibilities!
